triage_result.summary: User finds dashboard layout confusing, requests simplification.

reply_result.draft:
Dear Naveen,

Thank you for reaching out to us. I understand your frustration regarding the current dashboard layout and how confusing and difficult it is to navigate. We truly appreciate you bringing this to our attention and for your valuable feedback on simplifying it.

I want to confirm that your case has been received and escalated to our engineering team for review. A Jira ticket, RA-26, has been created to track this request.

Our team will be looking into your feedback, and you can expect an update from us within the next 48 hours.

Thanks,
Customer Support Team

Dear Naveen,

Thank you for reaching out to us.

I understand that having reports downloadable in CSV format would be very beneficial for your needs, and I appreciate you bringing this feature request to our attention.

I can confirm that your request has been received and escalated to our engineering team for review. A Jira ticket, RA-27, has been created for this feature request, and you can track its progress here: https://ragworks-ai.atlassian.net/browse/RA-27.

Our engineering team will review your request, and we aim to provide an update within 48 business hours.

Thanks,
Customer Support Team
